(

          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NOT NULL
          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IN ('v1', 'v2'))
        OR
        ("company_role_assignments"."bundle"::text IN ('company_document_registrar', 'company_commercial_intake', 'company_project_access') AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NOT NULL AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IN ('v1', 'v2'))

        OR
        ("company_role_assignments"."bundle"::text NOT IN ('company_director_client_access', 'company_task_manager', 'company_document_project_organizer', 'company_document_registrar', 'company_project_access', 'company_commercial_intake', 'company_service_catalogue', 'company_pricing_configuration', 'company_commercial_activity_reader', 'company_project_approver')
          AND "company_role_assignments"."permission_set_version" IS NULL)

client_duplicate_reviews_source_shape_ch.name: client_duplicate_reviews_source_shape_check

(

          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."registration_command_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."correction_command_id" IS NULL
          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_client_account_id" IS NULL

          AND "client_duplicate_reviews"."proposal_client_account_id" IS NOT NULL

working_documents_state_check.name: working_documents_state_check
working_documents_state_check.value: "working_documents"."type" = 'questionnaire' AND "working_documents"."confidentiality" = 'company-confidential' AND length(trim("working_documents"."title")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim("working_documents"."purpose")) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

project_responsibility_events_members_ch.name: project_responsibility_events_members_check
project_responsibility_events_members_ch.value:
("project_responsibility_events"."before_membership_id" IS NULL) = ("project_responsibility_events"."before_display_label" IS NULL)
        AND ("project_responsibility_events"."after_membership_id" IS NULL) = ("project_responsibility_events"."after_display_label" IS NULL)
        AND "project_responsibility_events"."before_membership_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "project_responsibility_events"."after_membership_id"

projects_lifecycle_responsible_check.name: projects_lifecycle_responsible_check
projects_lifecycle_responsible_check.value: "projects"."status" NOT IN ('active', 'on_hold') OR "projects"."responsible_membership_id" IS NOT NULL

projects_responsibility_revision_check.name: projects_responsibility_revision_check
projects_responsibility_revision_check.value:
(
        ("projects"."responsibility_revision" = 0
          AND "projects"."responsible_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_display_name" IS NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("projects"."responsibility_revision" >= 1
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_by_display_name" IS NOT NULL
          AND "projects"."responsibility_changed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

project_lifecycle_transitions_action_che.name: project_lifecycle_transitions_action_check
project_lifecycle_transitions_action_che.value:
(
        ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'activate' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."from_status" = 'preparatory' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."to_status" = 'active')
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'hold' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."from_status" = 'active' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."to_status" = 'on_hold')
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'resume' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."from_status" = 'on_hold' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."to_status" = 'active')
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'complete' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."from_status" = 'active' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."to_status" = 'completed')
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'cancel' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."from_status" IN ('preparatory', 'active', 'on_hold') AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."to_status" = 'cancelled')
      )

project_lifecycle_transitions_text_check.name: project_lifecycle_transitions_text_check
project_lifecycle_transitions_text_check.value:
(
        ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" IN ('hold', 'cancel') AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."note" IS NULL)
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" = 'complete' AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."note" IS NOT NULL AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."action" IN ('activate', 'resume') AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason" IS NULL AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."note" IS NULL)
      )
      AND ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason" IS NULL OR (length("project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason" = btrim("project_lifecycle_transitions"."reason")))
      AND ("project_lifecycle_transitions"."note" IS NULL OR (length("project_lifecycle_transitions"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "project_lifecycle_transitions"."note" = btrim("project_lifecycle_transitions"."note")))

project_start_declarations_items_check.name: project_start_declarations_items_check
project_start_declarations_items_check.value:
"project_start_declarations"."approved_offer" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."contract_or_precontract" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."project_plan" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."initial_documents" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."deadlines" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."financial_conditions" IN ('present', 'missing')
        AND "project_start_declarations"."risks" IN ('present', 'missing')

project_start_declarations_exception_che.name: project_start_declarations_exception_check
project_start_declarations_exception_che.value:
(
        "project_start_declarations"."approved_offer" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."contract_or_precontract" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."project_plan" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."initial_documents" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."deadlines" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."financial_conditions" = 'missing'
        OR "project_start_declarations"."risks" = 'missing'
      ) = ("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" IS NULL) = ("project_start_declarations"."completion_membership_id" IS NULL)
      AND ("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" IS NULL) = ("project_start_declarations"."completion_display_label" IS NULL)
      AND ("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" IS NULL) = ("project_start_declarations"."completion_due_date" IS NULL)
      AND ("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" IS NULL OR (length("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "project_start_declarations"."exception_reason" = btrim("project_start_declarations"."exception_reason")))
      AND ("project_start_declarations"."completion_due_date" IS NULL OR ("project_start_declarations"."completion_due_date" >= DATE '0001-01-01' AND "project_start_declarations"."completion_due_date" <= DATE '9999-12-31'))

tasks_date_check.name: tasks_date_check
tasks_date_check.value: "tasks"."due_date" IS NULL OR ("tasks"."due_date" >= DATE '0001-01-01' AND "tasks"."due_date" <= DATE '9999-12-31')

tasks_blockage_reason_check.name: tasks_blockage_reason_check
tasks_blockage_reason_check.value: "tasks"."blockage_reason" IS NULL OR (length("tasks"."blockage_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "tasks"."blockage_reason" = btrim("tasks"."blockage_reason"))

tasks_cancellation_reason_check.name: tasks_cancellation_reason_check
tasks_cancellation_reason_check.value: "tasks"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL OR (length("tasks"."cancellation_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND "tasks"."cancellation_reason" = btrim("tasks"."cancellation_reason"))

tasks_state_check.name: tasks_state_check
tasks_state_check.value:
("tasks"."status" IN ('todo', 'in_progress') AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blockage_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_display_name" IS NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" = 'blocked' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blockage_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_display_name" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_display_name" IS NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" = 'done' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_display_name" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blockage_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancellation_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_display_name" IS NULL)
        OR ("tasks"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."completed_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blockage_reason" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_membership_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_by_display_name" IS NULL AND "tasks"."cancellation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."cancelled_by_display_name" IS NOT NULL)

commercial_intake_events_action_metadata.name: commercial_intake_events_action_metadata_check
commercial_intake_events_action_metadata.value:
(
        ("commercial_intake_events"."action" = 'client_request.created'
          AND "commercial_intake_events"."metadata" = '{"requestVersion": 1}'::jsonb)
        OR
        ("commercial_intake_events"."action" = 'opportunity.created'
          AND "commercial_intake_events"."metadata" = '{"opportunityVersion": 1}'::jsonb)
        OR
        ("commercial_intake_events"."action" = 'opportunity.next_action.updated'
          AND jsonb_typeof("commercial_intake_events"."metadata" -> 'opportunityVersion') = 'number'
          AND "commercial_intake_events"."metadata" = jsonb_build_object('opportunityVersion', ("commercial_intake_events"."metadata" ->> 'opportunityVersion')::integer)
          AND ("commercial_intake_events"."metadata" ->> 'opportunityVersion')::integer >= 2)
      )

opportunities_last_update_check.name: opportunities_last_update_check
opportunities_last_update_check.value:
(
        ("opportunities"."version" = 1
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_by_internal_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_by_workspace_membership_id" IS NULL
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("opportunities"."version" >= 2
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_by_internal_user_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_by_workspace_membership_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "opportunities"."last_updated_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

commercial_catalogue_commands_result_sha.name: commercial_catalogue_commands_result_shape_check
commercial_catalogue_commands_result_sha.value:
(
        ("commercial_catalogue_commands"."command" = 'service_definition.create'
          AND "commercial_catalogue_commands"."result_service_definition_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "commercial_catalogue_commands"."result_offering_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("commercial_catalogue_commands"."command" = 'company_service_offering.create'
          AND "commercial_catalogue_commands"."result_service_definition_id" IS NULL
          AND "commercial_catalogue_commands"."result_offering_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

commercial_catalogue_events_action_metad.name: commercial_catalogue_events_action_metadata_check
commercial_catalogue_events_action_metad.value:
(
        ("commercial_catalogue_events"."action" = 'service_definition.created'
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."offering_id" IS NULL
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" - 'serviceDefinitionId' - 'code' - 'provenance' = '{}'::jsonb
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" ->> 'serviceDefinitionId' = "commercial_catalogue_events"."service_definition_id"::text
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" ->> 'provenance' = 'ILLUSTRATIVE')
        OR
        ("commercial_catalogue_events"."action" = 'company_service_offering.created'
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."offering_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" - 'serviceDefinitionId' - 'offeringId' - 'code' - 'provenance' = '{}'::jsonb
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" ->> 'serviceDefinitionId' = "commercial_catalogue_events"."service_definition_id"::text
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" ->> 'offeringId' = "commercial_catalogue_events"."offering_id"::text
          AND "commercial_catalogue_events"."metadata" ->> 'provenance' = 'ILLUSTRATIVE')
      )

pricing_configuration_events_action_meta.name: pricing_configuration_events_action_metadata_check
pricing_configuration_events_action_meta.value:
(
        "pricing_configuration_events"."action" = 'pricing_rule_version.published'
          AND "pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" - 'pricingRuleVersionId' - 'versionNumber' - 'provenance' = '{}'::jsonb
          AND jsonb_typeof("pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" -> 'pricingRuleVersionId') = 'string'
          AND "pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" ->> 'pricingRuleVersionId' = "pricing_configuration_events"."pricing_rule_version_id"::text
          AND jsonb_typeof("pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" -> 'versionNumber') = 'number'
          AND jsonb_typeof("pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" -> 'provenance') = 'string'
          AND "pricing_configuration_events"."metadata" ->> 'provenance' = 'ILLUSTRATIVE'
      ) IS TRUE

pricing_rule_versions_supersession_check.name: pricing_rule_versions_supersession_check
pricing_rule_versions_supersession_check.value:
(
        ("pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_by_version_id" IS NULL
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_at" IS NULL
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_from" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_by_version_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_from" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_by_version_id" <> "pricing_rule_versions"."id"
          AND "pricing_rule_versions"."superseded_from" > "pricing_rule_versions"."effective_from")
      )
